_notes: Squad roles and starting kits (design doc, Roles: proposed). A kit is base_kit plus the role's kit, as [item id, count] pairs, taken in order (carrier before plates). 'weapon_note' says what stands in for a weapon the item list doesn't have yet. fire_teams lists each team's slots in order; slots pair into battle buddies (1st+2nd, 3rd+4th). Every team keeps exactly one medic slot. Medical loadouts (design doc, The kit and Medics): the medic carries a trauma kit plus extra tourniquets, gauze, bandages, chest seals, splints, morphine and NPAs, IVs, an IO kit, fluids, a pressure bag, decompression needles, a pulse oximeter, epinephrine, atropine, adenosine, a defibrillator, a surgery kit, burn dressings and a hypothermia blanket; everyone else carries an IFAK. MOLLE: the base kit puts three double mag pouches and an IFAK pouch on the carrier; role kits add theirs (radio and binoculars for the team leader, a sustainment pouch and knife for the medic, grenade pouches for the grenadier...) before what goes in them.
